visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A woman with long brown hair, wearing a dark green ribbed polo shirt with a cream-colored collar and a gold watch, stands in profile against a white gallery wall. The wall displays minimalist text reading '2025 康永版畫展'. She has her arms crossed and looks towards an artwork. (2) The scene cuts to an outdoor architectural courtyard with red brick pillars and a staircase. A large, semi-transparent banner with a portrait hangs vertically. The woman enters from the right, leading a young boy in a light blue t-shirt and khaki pants by the hand. (3) Indoors at the exhibition, the woman tries to maintain a pose for the camera near a piece of art while the young boy moves restlessly in the foreground, disrupting the 'elegant' viewing experience. The lighting is bright and professional. (4) Close-up shots of various lenticular artworks on white easels. The woman points at the frames, demonstrating how the text and colors change as she moves. One piece transitions from a dark purple gradient to showing the Chinese characters for 'Worth it'. (5) The woman stands in front of a series of light-box style artworks, gesturing with her hands as she explains the concept. She is expressive with her facial movements, smiling and nodding. The background shows other visitors and exhibition structural elements like white frames. (6) In a high-end retail environment, possibly a museum shop or boutique, the woman and the boy examine a large, blue-covered book or portfolio on a counter. They are surrounded by shelves displaying luxury bags and shoes. (7) Close-up of a latte in a black paper cup. The latte art features the characters '值得的' (Worth it) printed in cocoa powder. The woman picks up the cup and takes a sip, looking directly at the camera with a satisfied expression. (8) The video ends with a text-heavy informational screen overlaying the woman drinking her coffee, detailing the exhibition's name, dates, and location in Taipei.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-pitched digital chime followed immediately by a fast-paced, upbeat electronic pop track with a strong 4/4 drum beat. The female narrator speaks with high energy and clarity, her voice layered over the bright synth music. (2) A subtle 'whoosh' sound effect transitions the scene. The narrator's speech rate increases as she describes the exhibition's materials. The background music remains consistent in tempo and volume, providing a cheerful bed for the dialogue. (3) Faint sounds of a public indoor space, like soft chatter and the rustle of clothes, are audible beneath the narration. The narrator's tone is warm and conversational, occasionally interrupted by the soft, higher-pitched voice of a young boy. (4) As the focus shifts to the coffee, a soft liquid slurping sound is heard, integrated into the mix. The BGM continues through the final informational screen, maintaining a high-energy finish with bright spectral characteristics.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a lifestyle vlog and promotional piece for Kevin Tsai's print exhibition. It uses a relatable 'Expectation vs. Reality' hook (parenting at an art show) to engage the audience before transitioning into an informative review of the artwork's unique lenticular materials and concluding with event details.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Detailed display of exhibition information, tagging the event location, and positive review of the art materials.
